schedule._note_max_per_day: profile setting chosen by the person, integer 1 to 43; 2 is the default proposal shown to the person; the most cv_submission sends per local calendar day, counted at send_started, failed attempts included; applies in every mode; 0 and 44 or more are refused; a change takes effect from the next local day; the monthly limit of 44 is fixed

minutes_per_application._note: estimate, change to your own values (asked in TODO_FOR_AI.md, A7); used only for the time-saved figure of the statistics (DATA_CONTRACT.md §9.3)

_allowed_values.languages.review_language: a language code the person checks the materials in (for example en, ru, de); null until asked (TODO_FOR_AI.md, A7); separate from the sending languages and the report language
_allowed_values.languages.cv_language: default CV language for vacancies whose language is not stated; the vacancy language decides for each application; null until asked
_allowed_values.languages.cover_letter_language: default cover letter language, same rule as cv_language; null until asked
_allowed_values.languages.email_language: default e-mail text language, same rule as cv_language; null until asked
_allowed_values.languages.report_language: en, ru or de, chosen by the person; independent of the other languages
_allowed_values.schedule.monthly_reminder_local_time: null until agreed in setup, then HH:MM local time (24 h); never assumed
_allowed_values.schedule.daily_check_time: HH:MM local time (24 h); default 16:00 in the person's time zone
_allowed_values.schedule.local_send_times: one or two HH:MM local times (24 h); one time per run unless a second time is chosen; an empty list with on_request
_allowed_values.schedule.max_per_run_note: 1 or 2 slots in one run of a scheduled cadence; null with on_request
_allowed_values.schedule.max_per_day: integer 1–43 (default proposal 2; the monthly limit 44 is fixed)
_allowed_values.schedule.inter_message_delay_minutes: null, or an integer of 1 or more; used when max_per_run is 2 and only one local time is given
_allowed_values.schedule.interval_days: null, or an integer of 1 or more; used only by every_n_calendar_days (calendar days) and every_n_allowed_workdays (permitted working days)
_allowed_values.schedule.cadence_on_request_note: on_request is allowed only with mail.mode approval_per_message: no fixed slot; the send time is the moment of the person's answer to the send card; no local_send_times, max_per_run, interval_days or inter_message_delay_minutes
